intro.name: Sebastian Šanda
intro.title: Full-Stack Developer
intro.description: For almost 10 years I've been building web and mobile apps – from React and Next.js frontends to NestJS APIs with GraphQL and PostgreSQL. I've worked on projects for Koh-I-Noor Deutschland, Zoetis and the Mobile Phone Museum. AI is part of my daily development workflow.

about.content:
I am a Full-Stack developer specializing in React, Next.js, and WordPress. I enjoy working on modern websites and applications that combine clean design with functionality. With more than 8 years of development experience, I am continuously learning and exploring new technologies.
In my free time, I focus on photography, graphic design, and video production, and I also enjoy exploring game development in Roblox Studio with great enthusiasm.
